description: Ticket T-10. Add unit tests for the share gate in src/main/share-gate.ts. One outgoing operation runs only after one passphrase confirmation. The product code does not change.
steps: Read global-sct/src/main/share-gate.ts, global-sct/src/shared/share.ts, and global-sct/tests/envelope.test.ts (for the test style).

Create global-sct/tests/share-gate.test.ts. Construct the real ShareGate with a `verify` function that you write in the test (it resolves for the correct passphrase and rejects for another) and a `changed` function that counts its calls.
Add one test for each line in tests.must_add. Read the active request with gate.current() to get the id for confirm().

For the expiry test only, use the node:test timer control `t.mock.timers.enable({ apis: ['setTimeout', 'Date'] })` and `t.mock.timers.tick(...)`. A real wait of 2 minutes is not permitted. Use no other mock.
From global-sct/tests run `bun test share-gate.test.ts`. From global-sct/ run each command in verification.
Commit the one new file with one commit.
acceptance_criteria: tests/share-gate.test.ts exists and each line of tests.must_add has a test
Each test uses the real ShareGate class
The operation function (`execute`) records its calls, and each test asserts the call count
No test waits for real time longer than 1 second
bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run lint, and bun run test pass, and `bun test share-gate.test.ts` passes

must_add: A wrong passphrase sends nothing: confirm rejects, the operation does not run, the request stays active, and a later correct confirm runs the operation one time and resolves run() with its result

Expiry: after 2 minutes the promise of run() rejects with 'This share confirmation expired. Start the share again.', current() is null, and the operation did not run; 1 millisecond before that time the request is still active
Cancel: run() rejects with 'The share was cancelled.', the operation does not run, and the next queued request becomes active
Clear on lock: clear() rejects the active request and each queued request with 'The vault is locked. Start the share again.', and current() is null
A second confirm during verification rejects with 'The passphrase is already being checked.', and the operation runs one time
Queue limit: with 1 active request and 8 queued requests, the next run() rejects with 'Wait for the current share confirmation to finish.'
confirm rejects an input with a wrong id, an input with no passphrase, and a call when no request waits; the operation does not run

mutations.find: if (this.confirming) throw new Error('The passphrase is already being checked.')
for (const entry of entries) entry.reject(new Error('The vault is locked. Start the share again.'))
